title: Naver Search Ad MCP Server (helloMAX Report Automation)
description: MCP server that automates collection of Naver Search Ad data and generates the helloMAX Report Excel (10-sheet template) automatically. Excludes 'brand search' sheet (no API support). Uses HMAC-signed Naver Search Ad API with credentials from .env (CUSTOMER_ID, ACCESS_LICENSE, SECRET_KEY).
constraints: TDD mode: tests first, then implementation
Credentials from .env via dotenv (no hardcoded secrets)
HMAC-SHA256 signing per Naver Search Ad API spec (timestamp ms . method . URI)
Brand search sheet (sheet 6) is intentionally excluded (API does not support area-level performance)
Output: 9 of 10 sheets generated (skip 'brand search 성과')
Korean column names preserved per template form

stories.title: Credential loader (ICredentialLoader + EnvCredentialLoader)
acceptanceCriteria: src/config/credentials.ts exports ICredentialLoader interface with load(): NaverAdsCredentials
EnvCredentialLoader reads NAVER_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID, NAVER_ADS_ACCESS_LICENSE, NAVER_ADS_SECRET_KEY (handles trailing space in key names)
Throws descriptive error when any of the 3 keys is missing (without echoing values)
Has [enumerable: false] on secret fields so console.log(credentials) does not leak
Unit tests cover: all-present, missing-one, missing-all, trailing-space-in-key
tests/credentials.test.ts passes via npm test

stories.title: HMAC signer (Naver spec exact)
acceptanceCriteria: src/api/signer.ts exports sign({timestamp, method, uri, secretKey}) -> base64 string
Implements HMAC-SHA256 over `${timestamp}.${method}.${uri}` (URI is path only, no query string)
buildHeaders({customerId, accessLicense, secretKey, method, uri}) returns headers object: X-Timestamp, X-API-KEY, X-Customer, X-Signature
Unit tests use fixture-capture pattern: given fixed inputs, output is deterministic
Test verifies signature for known input matches deterministic output (golden test)
tests/signer.test.ts has at least 4 cases: GET request, POST request, query-string-stripping, timestamp-ms-format

stories.title: Naver Search Ad API client (HTTP + retry)
acceptanceCriteria: src/api/client.ts exports NaverAdsClient class with constructor({baseUrl, credentials, signer})
client.get<T>(path, query?) and client.post<T>(path, body) methods
Builds X-Timestamp / X-API-KEY / X-Customer / X-Signature headers per request via signer
Retry semantics: 401 -> resign timestamp + retry once; 5xx -> exponential backoff 3 attempts; 429 -> respect Retry-After header
Unit tests with mocked fetch (vi.mock or msw): success path, 401 retry, 5xx backoff, 429 Retry-After
tests/client.test.ts passes

stories.title: StatReport async download flow (POST -> poll -> GZ -> TSV)
acceptanceCriteria: src/api/stat-reports.ts exports requestStatReport({reportTp, statDt}) -> Promise<{rows: object[]}>
Does POST /stat-reports, polls GET /stat-reports/{reportJobId} until status == 'BUILT'
Downloads downloadUrl, gunzips, parses TSV into objects (header row required)
Polling uses exponential backoff with 30s max interval, 10min total timeout

Supports reportTp values: AD, AD_DETAIL, AD_CONVERSION, AD_CONVERSION_DETAIL, EXPKEYWORD, SHOPPINGKEYWORD_DETAIL, SHOPPINGKEYWORD_CONVERSION_DETAIL, SHOPPINGBRANDPRODUCT, SHOPPINGBRANDPRODUCT_CONVERSION, BRND_CONTRACT (constants exported)
Unit test mocks the 3-step flow (request -> poll -> download) with fixture data
tests/stat-reports.test.ts passes

stories.title: Metadata API (campaigns, ad groups, keywords, products)
acceptanceCriteria: src/api/metadata.ts exports getCampaigns(), getAdGroups(campaignId?), getKeywords(adGroupId?), getProducts()
Each fetches /ncc/campaigns, /ncc/adgroups, /ncc/keywords, /ncc/product-groups respectively
Returns typed objects matching Naver API response shapes (defined in src/api/types.ts)
Unit tests verify request URL, query params, and response parsing with mocked fetch
tests/metadata.test.ts passes

src/raw/keyword.ts buildKeywordRaw({startDate, endDate}) returns 18-column rows (위 + 키워드)
src/raw/search-term.ts buildSearchTermRaw() returns 18-column rows (검색어)
src/raw/material.ts buildMaterialRaw() returns 20-column rows (소재ID/상품ID/상품명 추가)
월별/주차 columns are auto-derived from 날짜 via deterministic helper (utility tested separately)

4 conversion columns (구매완료/회원가입/신청완료/기타전환) populated from AD_CONVERSION reportTp's convTpCd breakdown
Unit tests use fixture API responses; no live API call in tests
tests/raw.test.ts passes for all 4 builders

Generates xlsx with 10 sheets in correct order: SUMMARY/매체별 성과/키워드 성과/상품 성과/검색어 성과/브랜드검색 성과/소재RAW/검색어RAW/일별RAW/키워드RAW
Brand search 성과 sheet exists but kept hidden (sheetState='hidden') with template structure (수기 입력 영역 placeholder)
Sheets with empty RAW data have hidden state (visibility toggled by data presence)
Korean column headers exactly match template form
Number formatting: 광고비 with thousand separators, CTR/CVR as percentage, etc.
Generated file opens in Excel/openpyxl without warnings (other than known unsupported extensions)
Unit test loads generated xlsx, asserts sheet names, visibility states, and at least one data row matches input

stories.title: MCP server (tools: list, fetch_raw, generate_report)
acceptanceCriteria: src/mcp/server.ts exports default MCP server using @modelcontextprotocol/sdk stdio transport
Tool 1: list_report_types -> returns supported reportTp constants and their descriptions
Tool 2: fetch_raw_data -> args: {reportTp, startDate, endDate}, returns {rows, count, reportTp}
Tool 3: generate_report -> args: {startDate, endDate, outputPath}, returns {path, sheetNames, rowCount}
Tool 4: validate_credentials -> calls a lightweight read endpoint (e.g., /billing/bizmoney) and returns {ok: true} or descriptive error (no secret leakage)
src/cli.ts is thin wrapper that boots the MCP server when run via `npx tsx src/cli.ts` or post-build via `node dist/cli.js`
package.json has bin entry pointing to dist/cli.js
Tools are registered with proper Zod schemas for input validation
Unit test: server boots, lists tools (4 tools registered), tool schemas validate
